root.label: Adaptors and flat containers
root.note: Narrow interfaces over real containers, and sorted vectors with a map interface.

children.label: What an adaptor is
children.note: It wraps an underlying container as a member and exposes a restricted interface.

children.label: Underlying container
children.note: A template parameter: deque for stack and queue, vector for priority_queue.

children.label: Required operations
children.note: queue needs pop_front, so vector fails at pop(); priority_queue needs random access.

children.label: No iteration
children.note: There are no iterators; pop() returns void, and top, front, pop on empty are undefined.

children.label: priority_queue
children.note: A heap kept in a random access container with push_heap and pop_heap.

children.label: Comparator direction
children.note: The top is the element that comes last: less gives a max-heap, greater a min-heap.

children.label: Const top
children.note: top() is const to protect the heap, so std::move(top()) copies instead of moving.

children.label: Moving out
children.note: Derive and use protected c and comp with pop_heap, then move from back().

children.label: Complexity
children.note: push and pop are logarithmic, top is constant, building from a range is linear.

children.label: Flat container layout
children.note: C++23 flat_map and flat_set wrap sorted sequence containers.

children.label: Two vectors
children.note: A flat_map keeps sorted keys and a parallel vector of values; flat_set keeps one sorted vector.

children.label: Trade-offs
children.note: Lookup is a cache-friendly binary search; insert and erase are linear; iteration is fast.

children.label: No nodes
children.note: No node handles or merge; insert and erase invalidate iterators and references like vector.

children.label: Construction and access
children.note: Bulk operations that trust the caller.

children.label: sorted_unique
children.note: Skips sorting; input that is unsorted or has duplicates is undefined behavior.

children.label: extract and replace
children.note: extract() moves out the keys and values containers; replace() needs equal sizes and sorted unique keys.

children.label: sorted_equivalent
children.note: The tag for multi variants: sorted input, equal keys allowed.

children.label: flat_map reference type
children.note: Dereferencing yields a prvalue pair of references.

children.label: Pair of references
children.note: reference is pair<const K&, V&> returned by value; value_type is pair<K, V>.

children.label: auto& fails
children.note: for (auto& [k, v] : m) is ill-formed; use auto&&, and know that auto still writes through.

children.label: Status and safety
children.note: Caveats for real-world use.

children.label: Exception safety
children.note: Two containers must stay in step; the reference documents no-effect only for single-element insertion.

children.label: Implementation status
children.note: GCC 16.2 libstdc++ and libc++ 21.1 ship the flat containers in C++23 mode.
